```yaml
name: Build Debian Packages

on:
  push:
    paths:
      - .github/workflows/build_deb.yml
  workflow_dispatch:
  release:
    types: [published]

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        variant: [basic, hardsubx]
    env:
      # Determine the package version: tag name if available, otherwise commit SHA
      VERSION: ${{ github.ref_type == 'tag' && github.ref_name || github.sha }}
      VARIANT: ${{ matrix.variant }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install build dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y \
            build-essential cmake git patchelf \
            libssl-dev libgmp-dev libmpfr-dev libz-dev \
            libjpeg-dev libtiff-dev libpng-dev libfreetype6-dev \
            liblcms2-dev libopenjp2-7-dev libwebp-dev \
            libavcodec-dev libavformat-dev libavutil-dev libswscale-dev \
            libavresample-dev libavdevice-dev libavfilter-dev

      - name: Build GPAC (abi-16.4)
        run: |
          git clone https://github.com/gpac/gpac.git
          cd gpac
          git checkout tags/abi-16.4
          make -j$(nproc)
          sudo make install DESTDIR=/tmp/gpac

      - name: Build ccextractor
        run: |
          mkdir -p /tmp/ccextractor
          cmake -S . -B build \
            -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=/tmp/ccextractor \
            -DWITH_OCR=${{ env.VARIANT == 'basic' && 'ON' || 'OFF' }} \
            -DWITH_FFMPEG=${{ env.VARIANT == 'hardsubx' && 'ON' || 'OFF' }}
          cmake --build build -j$(nproc)
          cmake --install build

      - name: Patch binary rpath
        run: |
          patchelf --set-rpath '$ORIGIN/../lib' /tmp/ccextractor/bin/ccextractor

      - name: Prepare Debian package
        run: |
          PKG_DIR=/tmp/package
          mkdir -p $PKG_DIR/DEBIAN $PKG_DIR/usr/bin $PKG_DIR/usr/lib
          cp /tmp/ccextractor/bin/ccextractor $PKG_DIR/usr/bin/
          cp /tmp/gpac/usr/local/lib/libgpac.so.* $PKG_DIR/usr/lib/
          cat > $PKG_DIR/DEBIAN/control <<EOF
          Package: ccextractor-${{ env.VARIANT }}
          Version: ${{ env.VERSION }}
          Section: utils
          Priority: optional
          Architecture: amd64
          Maintainer: CCExtractor <support@ccextractor.com>
          Depends: libstdc++6, libgcc1, libgmp10, libmpfr6, libssl1.1, libz1
          Description: CCExtractor ${VARIANT} variant
           CCExtractor is a tool for extracting closed captions from video files.
          EOF
          cat > $PKG_DIR/DEBIAN/postinst <<'EOF'
          #!/bin/sh
          set -e
          # No special actions needed
          EOF
          cat > $PKG_DIR/DEBIAN/postrm <<'EOF'
          #!/bin/sh
          set -e
          # No special actions needed
          EOF
          chmod 755 $PKG_DIR/DEBIAN/postinst $PKG_DIR/DEBIAN/postrm

      - name: Build .deb package
        run: |
          dpkg-deb --build /tmp/package
          mv /tmp/package.deb ccextractor-${{ env.VARIANT }}_${{ env.VERSION }}.deb

      - name: Upload artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: ccextractor-${{ env.VARIANT }}
          path: ccextractor-${{ env.VARIANT }}_${{ env.VERSION }}.deb

      - name: Upload release asset
        if: github.event_name == 'release'
        uses: actions/upload-release-asset@v1
        with:
          upload_url: ${{ github.event.release.upload_url }}
          asset_path: ccextractor-${{ env.VARIANT }}_${{ env.VERSION }}.deb
          asset_name: ccextractor-${{ env.VARIANT }}_${{ env.VERSION }}.deb
          asset_content_type: application/vnd.debian.binary-package
```
